newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Krakatau Steel sells stake in Citra Marga.
newsitem.headline: Krakatau Steel sells stake in Citra Marga.

text.p: Indonesia's state-owned steel manufacturer PT Krakatau Steel has sold 28.92 million shares, or a 2.892 percent stake, in toll road operator PT Citra Marga Nusaphala Persada (CMNP), the Jakarta stock exchange said.

"PT Krakatau Steel through a letter numbered 15/DU-KS/VI/1997 dated June 30, 1997, stated that it has sold a 2.892 percent stake (or 28.92 million shares in CMNP)," the exchange said in a statement received on Monday.
The statement said the deal was done at 2,000 rupiah per share on June 27. It did not reveal the buyer or other details.
Officials of Citra Marga and Krakatau Steel were not immediately available for comment.
Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported on Monday the share sale has reduced Krakatau Steel's stakeholding in CMNP to 5.998 percent from the previous 8.89 percent.
Citra Marga was unchanged at 1,425 rupiah in morning trading on Monday.
